evidence_plan.requirement: Datasets used in human language processing

payload.reason: The evidence discusses various datasets used in human language processing, including behavioral data (eye-tracking, self-paced reading) and neural data (EEG recordings).

claims.text: Heterogeneous datasets, including eye-tracking and EEG recordings, are used in human language processing.
Small datasets in human language processing can benefit from a multitask approach using diverse data.
